description: This file defines the DefaultsEntityForm class for Drupal's Layout Builder module, providing a form interface for editing layout defaults, including form building, message rendering, entity handling, and saving functionality.

classes.name: DefaultsEntityForm
classes.description: A form class for editing layout defaults within Drupal's Layout Builder module, handling form rendering, message display, entity management, and save operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with layout tempstore repository and entity type bundle info service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the layout builder form, adding attributes and message.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Generates a message indicating the entity being edited, based on entity type and bundle info.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Prepares the entity for editing, keeping it in sync with section storage.

methods.name: getEntityFromRouteMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the entity view display based on route parameters.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Builds form actions, extending parent actions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the section storage and logs a message indicating the layout was saved.
